title: land_housing -- additional structured fields
description: Recommended, not required by CI -- but strongly preferred over folding all of this into the claim text. These are universal across every PC; status_tag values (the local scheme names) are NOT -- those live in each PC's theme_colors.json.

regularization_scheme_status.description: Is this colony/area notified under whatever local regularisation scheme applies (e.g. Delhi's PM-UDAY)?

title_or_deed_issued.description: Have residents actually received ownership documents, not just scheme eligibility?

building_plan_sanctionable.description: Can a resident get a building plan legally approved here?

demolition_notice_active.description: Is there a current, active demolition/sealing notice on record?
